note: Adapted from the species-level description in Maiti's monograph on the world species of termites (Memoirs of the Zoological Survey of India); the original is in English; entry no. 80. The original notes that there were no specimens and that the description and figures follow Light (1921) and Moutia (1936). The soldier measurements are in Table 39 of the original, which is not in the source package and has therefore not been entered.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head pale yellow; antennae, labrum and abdomen paler; thorax and legs paler still. Head with moderate pilosity, slightly longer than wide, widest behind the compound eyes, narrowing posteriorly. Labrum as long as wide, its apex obtusely rounded, with 2—3 short bristles. Frons concave between the clypeus and the frontal gland pore. Postclypeus wider than long, convex, with a median groove. Compound eyes small, almost circular, the ommatidia distinct, situated a little behind the lateral margins of the head, their distance from the lower margin of the head equal to half the diameter of the compound eye. Ocelli absent. Frontal gland pore small, at about the midpoint between the clypeal suture and the posterior margin of the head. Antennae 17-segmented, with sparse short hairs, segments 2, 4 and 5 almost equal, segment 3 almost half of segment 2. Pronotum slightly wider than long, slightly narrower than the head, widest anteriorly, the anterior margin concave in the middle, the posterior margin almost circular. Meso- and metanotum narrower than the pronotum. Wing scale as long as the pronotum; wings straw-coloured. Media near the middle of the wing but closer to the cubitus than to the subcosta. Cubitus with 7—8 branches. Measurements (mm): wing length 9.10; body length without wings 3.50—4.00; head length including the labrum 1.10—1.12; head length to the frontal gland pore 0.50; head width 0.80; diameter of the compound eye 0.26; pronotum width 0.74; fore wing length 7.80; fore wing width 1.90.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head chestnut brown; labrum, base of the mandibles and pronotum paler; mandibles dark brown. Head and pronotum sparsely hairy, abdomen more densely hairy. Head subrectangular, lateral margins weakly convex, posterior margin rounded. Frontal gland pore indistinct, situated slightly above the middle; frontal gland transparent, triangular. Labrum lanceolate, with a transparent needle-like process. Mandibles nearly straight, the apical hook extremely weak. Antennae broken (could not be counted); segment 3 smallest, slightly longer than segments 2 and 4. Postmentum as long as the mandibles, widest just below the apical margin, the lateral angles distinctly projecting, the waist at the posterior 1/3. Pronotum narrower than the head, anterior margin convex with a distinct median incision, posterior margin weakly convex.
